$comment: The facade atlas of the desktop building shader (M10d2; 02-world-bake.md section 6 desktop row). texture/facade-atlas is a 4 x 4 grid of wall materials, authored by tools/assets/src/recipes/facade-atlas.ts: grey detail whose linear mean is `mean`, so the shader multiplies the class palette colour (the per-building tint) by `sample / mean` and the wall keeps its brightness. `tileM` is the wall width one tile covers; `classes` lists, in BuildingKind order (ResLow, ResMid, Commercial, Tower, Industrial, Civic), the tiles a building of that class picks from by its seed. Variants: desktop 1024 px (desktop-ultra, desktop), mobile 512 px (bound on `mobile` through M02h7's albedo seam, DL-740), mobile-low 256 px (the catalog's tier rule; mobile-low never requests it). No text, signs, logos or murals.
